description:
Leadstore tracks how your brand shows up in AI search — ChatGPT, Google, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Grok — and helps you act on what it finds.

Connect your Leadstore account and ask for things that would otherwise take several dashboards: your AI visibility score and the prompts you are cited in, share of voice against tracked competitors, keyword and content gaps, technical audit findings, and where your brand is being discussed on other sites.

You can also work on content in the conversation. Read a blog draft together with its quality report and the plan it was written from, edit the parts that need work, and watch the score update — then schedule or publish it to a connected CMS such as WordPress, Sanity or Framer.

The plugin acts as you, using your own Leadstore login through a standard OAuth sign-in, and you can revoke access at any time. A Leadstore account is required.

defaultPrompt: How visible is my site in AI search this month, and which prompts cite me?
Compare my offsite mentions with my tracked competitors
Show my latest blog draft's quality report and help me fix what's lowering the score
